answer: Each identity stakes 150 POA to carve one basalt haven into the shared cliff and seal it with a marble keystone engraved with their first job receipt; the haven opens only when its owner returns in person and taps the keystone three times while two neighbors watch; a forged keystone shatters the haven, the 150 POA is kept, and the owner is barred five epochs; ten clones need ten havens, ten keystones, and ten separate returns, 1,500 POA in all, no haven, keystone, or return shared or reused.
